      public void buy(String where, String itemId, long coins, int perDay, String fix)
      Players pay this many coins for one of the item here.
      Parameters:
      where - a few words, such as "the shop" or "the Iron stall"
      perDay - the most one player can buy here in a day (0 = no limit)
      fix - where to change the price (see Doctor)
